data.name: Gentle Rest
data.description: Your touch can fill a creature with lethargy, causing a living creature to become staggered for 1 round as a melee touch attack. If you touch a staggered living creatures, that creature falls asleep for 1 round instead. Undead creatures touched by you are staggered for %1 rounds. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|WIS|GentleRestTimes
